items.title: Banks and Asset Managers See Growth Continuing in 2027: 50 Outlooks from 37 Houses
items.summary: A summary of 50 outlooks for 2027 from 13 banks, 21 asset managers and 3 research and other firms, published September to November 2026. Covers growth, the Fed and the US 10-year yield, the S&P 500, gold, oil and currencies, AI investment, who gains from AI, bond duration and three named risks, followed by our view: the 10-year yield stays near 5%. Page 13 links to every report. Analysis: E9Technologies.
